name: groups-monorepo
description: Application de Répartition Aléatoire d'Étudiants - React / Express / MySQL / Pure Domain

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @groups/domain build && pnpm --filter @groups/api build && pnpm --filter @groups/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @groups/domain test && pnpm --filter @groups/api test && pnpm --filter @groups/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @groups/domain test:coverage && pnpm --filter @groups/api test:coverage && pnpm --filter @groups/web test
